audits.title: Audit of DNA & Disengagement of Patients in West Essex Community MH Teams
audits.setting: West Essex community mental health teams

cycle1.result: 98.1% notified adequately; letter to patient and GP 100%; risk assessment completed 50.9%, updated 25%; contingency plan reviewed 26; family contacted 3

audits.other_findings: Welfare checks done for 4 patients; 31 discharged after not responding.
audits.citation: Purakayastha R. Audit of DNA & Disengagement of Patients in West Essex Community MH Teams. BJPsych Open. 2023;9(Suppl 1):S178-S179.

audits.title: An Audit on Did Not Attend (DNA) Rate in the Learning Disability Outpatient Mental Health Setting, BCHFT
audits.standard: Trust DNA policy: ring patient after DNA, check awareness of appointment, discuss barriers and document
audits.setting: Learning disability outpatient mental health service, BCHFT

cycle1.result: 35/117 (29%) appointments were DNA. Staff telephoned 34% after the DNA but no policy-aligned details were documented; no contact for 57%; no documentation for 9%. 83% offered another appointment, 17% discharged to GP.

audits.other_findings: DNA was associated with male gender, living with family and neuropsychiatric comorbidity. Recommendations: adapt DNA policy for this group and raise awareness at induction.
audits.citation: Fazal ur Rehman A, Vella J. An Audit on Did Not Attend (DNA) Rate in the Learning Disability Outpatient Mental Health Setting, BCHFT. BJPsych Open. 2025;11(S1):S235-S235. doi:10.1192/bjo.2025.10588.

audits.title: Exploring Non-Attendance Rates in the Tri-Borough Perinatal Service: An Audit of Demographic and Socioeconomic Predictors
audits.standard: Service target non-attendance (DNA) rate of 15% or lower for initial assessments
audits.setting: Tri-Borough Perinatal Service (Ealing, Hounslow, Hammersmith and Fulham)

cycle1.result: Overall DNA rate 35.3% (n=100), exceeding the target.

audits.other_findings: DNA rates were higher for physical centre appointments (40.0% vs 20.7% home and 25.9% remote; p=0.035) and with greater deprivation (p<0.001); ethnicity not significant (p=0.062).
audits.citation: Jolugbo P, Carey J. Exploring Non-Attendance Rates in the Tri-Borough Perinatal Service: An Audit of Demographic and Socioeconomic Predictors. BJPsych Open. 2025;11(S1):S248-S248. doi:10.1192/bjo.2025.10614.

audits.title: Audit of Dna/disengagement Guideline in the North Essex Specialist Community Mental Health Team (Scmht), Essex Partnership University Nhs Foundation Trust (Eput)
audits.standard: EPUT DNA/disengagement guideline (April 2018, amended August 2022): document risk-based actions, liaise with carers/GP, offer another appointment, review care plan, discuss in MDT
audits.setting: North Essex Specialist Community Mental Health Team, Essex Partnership University NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: Documenting risk 48.2%; risk management plans 49.4%; notifying professionals/MDT 50.5%; offered another appointment 77.6%; confirming appointments 94.1%; contacting patients after DNA 81.1%.

audits.intervention: Increased staff awareness of the trust guideline and the importance of documenting the action plan

cycle2.result: Documenting risk 95%; risk management plans 58%; notifying professionals/MDT 60%; offered another appointment 92%; confirming appointments 92%; contacting patients after DNA 74%.

audits.other_findings: Confirming appointments and contacting patients after DNA fell. A disengagement care plan and decision support tool are recommended.
audits.citation: Kumari R, Papanna B. Audit of Dna/disengagement Guideline in the North Essex Specialist Community Mental Health Team (Scmht), Essex Partnership University Nhs Foundation Trust (Eput). BJPsych Open. 2026;12(S1):S315-S315. doi:10.1192/bjo.2026.11673.

audits.title: Internal audit of attendances at a psychiatry outpatient clinic.
audits.standard: Locally set standards for patterns of attendance at the outpatient clinic
audits.setting: Adult psychiatry outpatient clinic, Mater Misericordiae University Hospital, Dublin

cycle1.result: Non-attendance 13.9%; 30.1% attended without an appointment; 20.4% inappropriate attendances; 2.2% outside catchment.

audits.intervention: Protocols for attenders without appointment and for streamlining prescriptions, plus renewed emphasis on transferring out-of-catchment patients.

cycle2.result: Non-attendance unchanged; without appointment 9.3% (significant decrease); inappropriate attendances 9.3% (not significant); outside catchment 2.3%.

audits.citation: Kelly BD. Internal audit of attendances at a psychiatry outpatient clinic. Ir J Psychol Med. 2008;25(4):136-140. doi:10.1017/s0790966700011253. PMID: 30282251.

audits.title: Setting up school-based diabetes clinics to engage adolescents who frequently 'were not brought to clinic' and improve self-management.
audits.setting: Paediatric diabetes service with clinics in five local secondary schools (Newcastle)

cycle1.result: 9/17 frequent non-attenders not seen at least once in 3 months.

audits.intervention: Quarterly school-based diabetes clinics with a nurse and physician from January 2017.

cycle2.result: Hospital WNB rate fell by 50% in the intervention group; patients not seen at least once in 3 months fell to 1/17.

audits.other_findings: Uncovered knowledge gaps, emotional difficulties and issues such as poor school attendance and bullying.
audits.citation: Alins Sahun Y, Camara K, Gething K, Shenck D, Gane J, Tse Y. Setting up school-based diabetes clinics to engage adolescents who frequently 'were not brought to clinic' and improve self-management. Arch Dis Child. 2020;105(6):598-599. doi:10.1136/archdischild-2018-315313. PMID: 31005894.
